latin: Vbicunque datur aliqua natura composita ex pluribus naturis actu in ea remanentibus, semper in ea nobilior est substantialiter, aliae accidentaliter.
translation: Wherever some nature composed of several natures actually remaining in it is found, in it the nobler nature is always present substantially, and the others accidentally.
